evals.prompt: We run a Next.js landing page for an AI note-taking app, $10/mo, at notely.app. There is no .agents folder yet. The repo has app/page.tsx (hero with <Button href="/signup">Start free</Button> at line 42), app/signup/page.tsx that redirects to /welcome on success, and Plausible in app/layout.tsx. Set up our conversion context.
evals.expected_output: Looks for an existing .agents/conversion.md first, then reads the repo for the homepage, main button and sign-up route before asking. Writes one goal detectable in code or URL, the main button with file and line, tools in place, and unmeasured fields marked.
assertions: Checks for an existing .agents/conversion.md before asking questions
Names exactly one goal and how it is detected
Records the main button with a file path
Marks unknown numbers as unmeasured instead of guessing
Uses the template sections (Site, Goal, Main button, Buyer, Tools, Already tried)

evals.prompt: Our goals are signups, demo bookings and newsletter subscribers. We get about 40 signups, 3 demo bookings and 25 newsletter joins a week. Put them all in the conversion file.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back to one goal, explains why the other skills need one, and runs or points to conversion-goal to choose. Keeps the other two as notes, not goals.
assertions: Keeps a single goal in the Goal section
Points to or runs conversion-goal to choose
Keeps the other actions as secondary notes, not goals
